responsibility: Declares the bootstrap exception-registration interface for the GNU Modula-2 SysExceptions module. The header defines the callback type used for language-level exception handlers and exposes SysExceptions_InitExceptionHandlers, which accepts handlers for index, range, case, invalid-location, function-return, whole/real/complex arithmetic, protection, system, coroutine, and generic exception conditions so the runtime implementation can later connect those procedures to host signal-driven fault handling.
same_name_distinction: Unlike GSysExceptions.c, which stores callbacks and installs/dispatches host signal handlers such as SIGBUS, SIGSEGV, and SIGFPE, this header only defines the exception-callback wrapper type and declares SysExceptions_InitExceptionHandlers for clients to register those handlers.
